title: Anniversary Summit
description: Anniversary Summit Register Now Ontario Nature Annual Gathering 2024 © Jenna Quinn 95th Anniversary Summit Ontario Nature’s Anniversary Summit will be held in Kingston on Saturday, June 13, 2026 from 8am to 5pm. The day’s activities will include hands-on workshops, thought-provoking presentations, guided field trips and our 95th Annual General Meeting . description: Browse our programs Browse our programs We have a variety of options to help you on your mental health journey. In some cases, intake is required. Simply put, intake is a session by appointment with a Stella’s Place Intake Social Worker to gather some information, understand your goals, and determine a support plan. At Stella’s Place, we provide free mental health services for young adults aged 16 to 29 and living in Toronto (with an M postal code). Our programs are divided into 3 categories: drop-in , by appointment and registered . For appointments and registered programs, you may be added to a waitlist. BeanBagChat Get one-on-one support online. Click the chat icon in the lower right corner on any page on www.stellasplace.ca to start chatting with a counsellor. description: Stuck on the bus: Toronto's 2024 budget offers no relief for Scarborough’s weary commuters Jan 13, 2024 Residents and transit advocates see the lack of busway funding as the latest example of how the area has been neglected by politicians at city hall and Queen’s Park. Successive administrations have spent decades playing political ping-pong with the replacement for the aging RT — at one point it was going to be an LRT — ultimately leaving Scarborough residents today without rapid transit for years. “Sometimes it feels like the city views Scarborough residents’ time as less valuable," said Krissan Veerasingam, board member for transit advocacy group TTCriders.
